lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 7-8 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a semi-ordered grid posterior to the gill slits, with spacing increasing towards the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Approximately 12 vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary spot rows, creating a distinct checkerboard grid pattern across the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by sharp high-to-low luminance gradients from dorsal to ventral edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 18-22 high-luminance spots distributed across the surface, with a higher concentration observed toward the posterior trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A cluster of dark, elongated pixels is visible attached to the ventral region near the pectoral fin base, characteristic of remora presence.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of significantly smaller micro-spots compared to the primary lateral flank blobs.
